concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-wechat-pay-wechat-pay-in-app-payments-enable-wechat-pay]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured WeChat Pay in-app setup guide for WeChat developer/app registration, AppID/AppSecret handoff to Adyen Support and conditional own-integration mobile SDK steps; setup does not prove payment or settlement.
warnings: The app-registration section says Android but includes an iOS-only App Store link and Bundle ID field.
The guide's settlement language describes the stated purpose of passing app credentials to Adyen Support, not observed settlement or live eligibility.
